rv.q: Like the script, designer Samal Blak’s wedding outfits treat the guests with both humour and respect. Till the Stars Come Down is serious, uproarious fun.

Steel’s script is sharply observed and often very funny, enlivened by spikily natural dialogue. Her writing nails a particular blend of earthy idiom, passive-aggressive snipping and blunt honesty that instantly evokes the Midlands setting.
Beth Steel makes a stirring West End debut with her poignant play for today
